Description
Pet-Friendly 4-Bedroom Home for Rent at 2244 W 32nd Ave, Vancouver. $5,600/month, available now. 4 bedrooms (2 on the main floor and 2 in the basement) and 3 bathrooms (primary-bedroom ensuite, additional main-floor bathroom, and basement bathroom). Pet friendly. School catchments: Trafalgar Elementary (K-7) and Prince of Wales Secondary (Grades 8-12); catchments and enrolment availability should be confirmed with the Vancouver School Board. Tenant pays gas, water, and electricity. Garden maintenance is the tenant's responsibility. Managed by Luxmore Realty.
